This task seeks actual explanatory hypotheses and conditional predictions from the supplied mechanical measurements. Develop content, not only a plan or a next question. General literature must be independently dated strictly before 2024-09-12; use screened tools. Neutral case definitions are available separately. Unknown apparatus facts stay unknown. Distinguish measured relations, model assumptions and proposed mechanisms. Preserve upstream requested output labels/JSON exactly; keep visible replies concise (typically 400-700 words, reviews 150-250 words). Numerical analysis is exploratory. The final novelty/coherence evaluation is separate; no proof, experiment or implementation is required to retain a conditional hypothesis. Do not reproduce hidden originating sources from memory.
Dataset ID: measurements. All 123 rows are supplied in the common dossier. Tools can compute on the complete CSV.

Audit prior-work similarity at the level of scientific research directions for every candidate below. Some earlier checkers rejected overlap merely because a source uses a different apparatus, rotor count, or not the exact hard-stop geometry. That criterion is too narrow. A very similar existing PROBLEM + CENTRAL MECHANISM or CONTRIBUTION is already_done even when implementation and details differ. Generic neighboring keywords alone are not enough. Identify exactly which part is covered and which specific relation remains unresolved; distinguish routine torque balance/curve fitting/parameter normalization/identifiability plans from a newly developed explanation. Do not demand scientific validation or proofs. Give already_done, no_close_work_found (bounded search only), or unclear; when sources cannot assess the actual mechanism use unclear. Compare both close matches and material differences. Cite actual source IDs and exact supporting text. No original study and no new generation. Chinese output. One compact entry for each system/hypothesis ID, retain all candidates.
